answer.rationale: Run a narrowly targeted, retention-focused pricing test for price-sensitive SMB accounts with active churn signals—not a broad acquisition discount. The recovered source behind memory_73 showed acquisition and qualified-revenue lift but a 12% decline in 30-day retention, so promotional pricing is not validated as sustainable. Use a holdout, limited duration, and renewal-level qualified-revenue and retention guardrails; stop if preserved accounts do not offset discounting and downstream churn.
